# WishMerge

> WishMerge aggregates discounted tech gadgets and gift ideas from across the web to help users discover deals on electronics and curate wishlists.

WishMerge is a product discovery and gift recommendation platform that specializes in tech gadgets, electronics, and crowdfunding items. The site leverages affiliate partnerships with major retailers like Amazon to surface discounted products and help users find the perfect gifts.
